title: On the asymptotic behaviour of $\alpha$-divergence generalized posteriors
abstract: arXiv:2610.35330v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the asymptotic behaviour of the solutions to the unconstrained generalized variational inference problem regularized by an $\alpha$-divergence. Under mild conditions, the minimizer is explicit up to a scalar normalizing constant, and we show that it admits a rescaling under which it converges in $L^1$ to a fixed non-Gaussian law, at a concentration scale around the empirical loss minimizer that departs from the typical $n^{-1/2}$ in the classical Bernstein--von Mises theorem. For $\alpha\in(0,1)$ and $d<2/(1-\alpha)$ the limit is a Student-$t$ distribution and the posterior width shrinks faster than the sampling error of the empirical minimizer. Conversely, for $\alpha>1$ the limiting distribution is a compactly supported Pearson type-II distribution, and the posterior width shrinks more slowly than the sampling error. translated_title: 关于α-散度广义后验的渐近行为
translated_abstract: 我们研究了由α-散度正则化的无约束广义变分推断问题之解的渐近行为。在温和的条件下，极小化子在相差一个标量归一化常数的意义下是显式的，并且我们证明它在某个重新缩放下于L¹中收敛到一个固定的非高斯分布，其围绕经验损失极小化子的集中尺度偏离了经典Bernstein–von Mises定理中典型的n^{-1/2}。当α∈(0,1)且d<2/(1-α)时，极限分布为Student-t分布，且后验宽度比经验极小化子的采样误差收缩得更快；相反，当α>1时，极限分布为紧支撑的Pearson II型分布，且后验宽度比采样误差收缩得更慢。KL散度（α=1）是α-散度族中唯一一个其后验宽度…（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明α-散度正则化的广义后验经重缩放后收敛于非高斯极限分布——α<1时为Student-t分布且收缩快于经典n^{-1/2}速率，α>1时为紧支撑Pearson II型分布且收缩更慢——而KL散度是α-散度族中唯一保持经典集中速率的成员。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that α-divergence regularized generalized posteriors converge after rescaling to fixed non-Gaussian laws—a Student-t with faster-than-classical contraction for α<1 and a compactly supported Pearson type-II with slower contraction for α>1—while KL divergence is the unique member of the family retaining the classical Bernstein–von Mises concentration rate.
